args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP` instead of banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), violating FIN-212 and causing `tests/test_money.py` to fail (2.665 must round to 2.66).

## Change
- Import `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` and use it in `round_money`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `test_half_even`.
